about.title: Zvinoreva IPEACE
about.subtitle: IPEACE inobatsira vanamuzvinabhizinesi neveSME veZimbabwe kutanga, kutevera mitemo, nekukura nemazano anoshanda.

innovation.description: Tinoedza nzira dzinoshanda dzinorerutsa basa renyu uye dzinogadzirisa dambudziko rebhizinesi.

precision.description: Tinotarisa mashoko, tinonyora sarudzo, uye tinopa mazano akajeka amunogona kushandisa.

empowerment.title: Kusimbisa
empowerment.description: Tinodzidzisa timu yenyu uye tinosiya zvishandiso zvinobatsira kuti mufambise basa mega.

agility.title: Kukurumidza
agility.description: Tinoongorora basa nguva nenguva kuti tigadzirise zvinokosha kana zvinodiwa zvichichinja.

compliance.description: Tinoronga zvinodiwa, tigadzirire magwaro, uye tinokubatsirai kusangana nenguva dzakatarwa.

excellence.title: Kunaka
excellence.description: Tinobvumirana zvinotarisirwa, tinogara tichizivisa mafambiro, uye tinopa basa ragadzirira kushandiswa.

services.subtitle: Wana rutsigiro rwakajeka uye runoshanda kuti utange, utungamire, nekukudza bhizinesi rako muZimbabwe nechivimbo.

cta.subtitle: Wana matanho akajeka ekusimbisa kutevedzera mitemo nekufambisa bhizinesi rako mberi.

documents.description: Gadzirira magwaro nemafaira ebhizinesi nemazvo pasina kunonoka kusiri madikanwa.

support.description: Wana rutsigiro runokurumidza kana paine mibvunzo yechimbi-chimbi yebhizinesi kana yekutevedzera mitemo.

team.title: Sangana neTimu Yedu Yenyanzvi
team.subtitle: Timu yedu yakasiyana yenyanzvi dzemitemo, nyanzvi dzezvirongwa zvebhizinesi, uye nyanzvi dzetekinoroji inouya nemakore mazhinji akabatanidzwa mukuita imwe neimwe kubasa nevatengi.

testimonials.title: Zvinotaura Vatengi Vedu
testimonials.subtitle: Usangoona mashoko edu chete. Aya ndiwo mashoko anotaura vatungamiri vebhizinesi muZimbabwe nezveruzivo rwavo rweIPEACE.

footer.cookiesComingSoon: Peji reMutemo weCookie riri kuuya munguva pfupi

acceptance.title: Kugamuchira Mamiriro
acceptance.content: Nekupinda kana kushandisa masevhisi aipeace Professional Consulting, unogamuchira kuti unovharwa neMamiriro aya uye mitemo yese yekutevera yemitemo yeZimbabwe. Kana usingagamuchiri chero chipi chinovakwa mazwi aya, haufanirwi kushandisa masevhisi edu.

useOfService.title: Kushandisa Masevhisi
useOfService.content: Masevhisi edu anopiwa kune zvakakodzera zvebhizinesi muZimbabwe. Unogamuchira kuti usashandise masevhisi edu kune zvinhu zvose zvisina mitemo kana zvisinakodzera zvinosanganisira zvisina kugara kana zvinotevera:
prohibited: Kuvhiringa mitemo yose kana mitemo yekutevera muZimbabwe
Kutumira software yakaipa kana kodhi yakaipa
Kupoteredza kuvimba kana kushandisa masevhisi edu

intellectualProperty.title: Nenguwo dzeAkabatwa
intellectualProperty.content: Zvose zviri mukati, zvinokurudzirwa, uye nenguwo dzeakabatwa dzakabatwa neIPEACE services ndidzaIPEACE Professional Consulting kana vashandisi vayo. Haufanirwi kushandisa nenguwo dzedu dzakabatwa pasina mvumo yekunyora.

termination.title: Kupera
termination.content: Tinodzivirira kodzero yekupera kana kudzima kufikira masevhisi edu nenguva chero ine, pasina kuzivisa, kune zvinoitwa zvisina kutevera mazwi aya kana zvinoitwa zvinodzudzira vatengi vamwe.

disclaimer.title: Kuzivisa Mavirango
disclaimer.content: Masevhisi edu anopiwa se 'sega uye 'sega avo' mazvo. IPEACE haifaniri kupa mavirango, akabuda kana akavanda, nezve kushandisa kana kuvapo kwezvose zvedu.

limitationOfLiability.title: Kudzikisa Mhosho
limitationOfLiability.content: IPEACE haizofanirwi kubhadharisa zvinhu zvose zvisina zvakanaka, zviri mukati, zvakakosha, zvinobva kana zvinodzudza, zvinosanganisira kuponya zvamapera, data, kana zvinangwa zvebhizinesi, zvinobuda kana zvinobatana nekushandisa masevhisi edu.

governingLaw.title: Mitemo Yekutevera
governingLaw.content: Mamiriro aya ekushandisa anofanira kuteverwa uye kunyengerwa kufhata nezve mitemo yeZimbabwe, pasina kufunga nezve kupoteredza mitemo yacho.

changesToTerms.title: Kuchinja Mamiriro
changesToTerms.content: Tinodzivirira kodzero yekuchinja Mamiriro aya ekushandisa nenguva chero ine. Zvichinja zvichava zvinoshanda mukati momupinda. Kufamba kwako kushandisa masevhisi edu kunoratidza kugamuchira zvichinja zvacho.

contact.title: Kubata
contact.content: Kana uine mibvunzo nezve Mamiriro aya ekushandisa, ndapota tibate nezvedu zvinotevera:

introduction.title: Kutanga
introduction.content: IPEACE Professional Consulting inokumbira kuchengetedza kuvanzika kwako uye ruzivo rwako. Mutemo weKuvanzika uyu unoratidza kuti tinozungusha, tishandisa, uye tichengetedza ruzivo rwako kana ukashandisa masevhisi edu.

personal.title: Ruzivo Rwakamupiro
personal.content: Tinozungusha ruzivo rwakamupiro rwaunotipa kune tivedu kana ukashandisa masevhisi edu, zvinosanganisira:
examples: Zita uye zviri kubata (email, runhare, kero)

usage.title: Ruzivo Rwekushandisa
usage.content: Tinozungusha ruzivo pamwe nekuti unoshandisa masevhisi edu, zvinosanganisira:
examples: Mapeji aunoenda uye nguva yaunogara pawebsite yedu

howWeUseInformation.title: Kuti Tishandisei Ruzivo Rwako
howWeUseInformation.content: Tishandisa ruzivo rwako kune zvinhu zvakawanda zvebhizinesi, zvinosanganisira:
purposes: Kupa uye kuvandudza masevhisi edu ekubvunzurudza
Kubata newe nezve mibvunzo uye zvikumbiro zvako
Kutumira zvitsva uye zvakabatwa zvekushambira (nemvumo yako)
Kuongorora maitiro ekushandisa kuvandudza ruzivo rwevatengi

dataProtection.title: Kuchengetedza Data
dataProtection.content: Tinorongedza nzira dzakanaka dzetekinoroji uye kugadzirisa kwekuponesa kuchengetedza ruzivo rwako kubva kupinda kusashandiswa, kuziviswa, kuchinja, kana kudzima.

sharingOfInformation.title: Kugovera Ruzivo
sharingOfInformation.content: Hatitengesi, kugovera, kana kutengesa ruzivo rwako kune vamwe. Tingagovera ruzivo mukati mezvinotevera:
cases: Kana zvinodikanwa nemutemo kana kuti kuchengetedza kodzero uye zviri kwedu

yourRights.title: Kodzero Dzako
yourRights.content: Une kodzero dzakasiyana nezve ruzivo rwako, zvinosanganisira:
rights: Kodzero yekupinda uye kugamuchira kopi yedada yako
Kodzero yekugadzirisa kana kuvandudza ruzivo rusingakodzwi

dataRetention.title: Kuchengeta Data
dataRetention.content: Tinochengeta ruzivo rwako kanguva inodikanwa kuparira masevhisi edu uye kutevera mitemo. Nguva yekuchengeta inochinja zvichifananidzwa nerudzi rweruzivo uye chinangwa.

cookies.title: Kuki uye Tekinoroji Yekutevera
cookies.content: Tishandisa kuki uye tekniroji dzimwe dzekutevera kuvandudza ruzivo rwako uye kuponza nhoroondo dzekushandisa. Unogona kudzora zvifanekiso chekukuki kuburikidza nepaonero rekushandisa runyararo rwako.

thirdPartyLinks.title: Mabatanidzwa eVamwe
thirdPartyLinks.content: Masevhisi edu anogona kuve nemabatanidzwa ekune mawebhusaiti evamwe. Hatinozvifukidzi kune zviri kuitwa zvavanhu vamwe kana zviri mukati mawebhusaiti aya. Tinokukokurudza kuti mutoronese mitemo yevanhu vamwe.

childrenPrivacy.title: Kuvanzika kweVana
childrenPrivacy.content: Masevhisi edu haasi ekune vana vasati wana makore 18. Hatinozungusha ruzivo rwakamupiro kubva kune vana kusina mvumo yedu.

changesToPolicy.title: Kuchinja Mutemo Uyu
changesToPolicy.content: Tinogona kugadzirisa Mutemo weKuvanzika yedu nenguva dzose. Tichazivisa pamwe nekuchinja kuburikidza nepaunopinda mupage uyu uye kugadzirisa zuva 'Rakapedzisira Kugadziriswa'.

contact.title: Tibate
contact.content: Kana uine mibvunzo kana zvinhu zvinokanganisa nezve Mutemo Uyu weKuvanzika kana zvimwe zvedu zvekushandisa data, ndapota tibate pa:

chatbot.subtitle: Bvunza nezve mitemo yebhizinesi yeZimbabwe
chatbot.welcome: Mhoro! Ndini mubatsiri wako akadzidziswa nezve Companies Act neSecurities regulations dzeZimbabwe. Ndingakubatsira sei nhasi?

consultation.title: Ronga Kubvunzurudza
consultation.subtitle: Ronga kubvunzurudza kwakasarudzika netimu yedu yenyanzvi. Sarudza zuva rako, nguva, uye nzira yekusangana.

success.title: Kubvunzurudza Kwarongwa Zvakanaka!
success.message: Tinotenda kuda kuronga kubvunzurudza neIPEACE. Tichakubata munguva pfupi kuti tisimbise musangano wako.
steps: Tichaongorora chikumbiro chako tikakubata mukati memaawa makumi maviri nemana

Uchagamuchira calendar invitation ine ruzivo rwekusangana

faq.shareTitle: Mibvunzo Inowanzo Bvunzwa - Mibvunzo yeBhizinesi Yapindurwa | IPEACE
faq.shareText: Ona mibvunzo inowanzo bvunzwa pamusoro pebhizinesi nekutevedzera mitemo muZimbabwe.

cta.title: Muchine mibvunzo pamusoro pekutevedzera mitemo yebhizinesi muZimbabwe?
cta.subtitle: Vanachipangamazano vedu vanogona kupindura mubvunzo upi zvawo pamusoro pekunyoresa kambani, zvinodiwa pakutevedzera mitemo, kana marezinesi ebhizinesi muZimbabwe.
